propositions: The bridge is hard-wired to a single tracker project at three points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair, and applier cross-project guard, preventing teams from syncing multiple projects against one codebase.

Store owns a project-to-repos mapping at .bridge_state/projects.json to remove the failure mode where two repos fetching different project subsets would each diff the other's projects as remote deletions.

Tickets hold a tri-state project field (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit-key=sync-there) and are migrated with zero event writes via an idempotent ensure unit seeding legacy defaults.
Multi-project inbound fetch iterates the configured project set for base JQL and three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results into one snapshot keyed by issue.
A store with >1 project must carry multi-project-bridge capability stamp in required_capabilities, failing closed on older binaries, while single-project stores remain writable by existing binaries.
Outbound dispatch uses per-ticket project on create and relaxes the cross-project guard from single project to set membership check.
